title: Add centered subtitle under Dashboard heading on Home page

requirements.text: On the main Home Dashboard page (`frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx`), add a new centered subtitle text directly below the "Dashboard" heading that displays exactly: "Be honest & mark attendance". Style it to be clean and minimal: slightly smaller than the Dashboard title, medium font weight, subtle opacity (~80–90%), with proper vertical spacing so it does not look crowded. The text color must be theme-aware and adapt correctly to dark mode using existing theme-based text colors (no harsh bright colors). Do not change any dashboard functionality, do not modify the existing layout structure beyond inserting this single line of text, and do not affect responsiveness or mobile spacing.

quotes: Below the Dashboard section/title, add the following text: "Be honest & mark attendance"
Use slightly smaller font than the Dashboard title
Text color should adapt properly to dark mode
Do NOT Change any dashboard functionality / Modify layout structure / Affect responsiveness / Break mobile view spacing

acceptanceCriteria: Home Dashboard renders the exact text "Be honest & mark attendance" immediately below the "Dashboard" heading.
The new text is center-aligned, uses a slightly smaller font than the "Dashboard" title, medium font weight, and reduced opacity (~80–90%).
Spacing between the "Dashboard" heading and the new text is present and looks uncluttered on both mobile and desktop widths.
Text uses theme-based colors and remains readable in light and dark modes without using harsh bright colors.
No other Home Dashboard behavior, existing layout sections, or responsiveness changes as a result of this update.

constraints: Frontend changes must not edit any immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not change any dashboard functionality or business logic.
Do not modify the overall Home Dashboard layout structure other than inserting the single subtitle line.
Must remain responsive and not break mobile spacing.
nonGoals: Changing any attendance calculations, state, or backend behavior.
Redesigning the Home Dashboard header area beyond adding the requested single line of text.
Adding new settings, toggles, animations, or navigation changes related to this subtitle.
